title: Verkar cool
body: Helt ny med appen men den verkar faktiskt ganska bra. Synd bara att man inte kan köra den helt på svenska
author: Gabbepojken

title: Great app that is evolving every day based on the users opinions and needs
body: I’m very happy with Numo. It helps me to stay on Track with my everyday life routines. As  an ADHD-er its hard for me to stick to routines by default, but This app does the trick for me. Also i love that there’s a buildt in community and such a warm feeling all over!
author: Garteus

title: Too expensive
body: The app looks nice but has too many unnecessary animations that distract. The app doesn’t really encourage to do things and is way too expensive for what it is - just a reminder app with beautiful design.
author: Azulzinho

title: This is outrageous!
body:
I have cancelled the app but the subscription keeps going!!!!!

author: SusanaMariaIsabel

title: Not easy
body: Hello, I do not understand how to close the account, as I do not want to pay for this service as it does not suit me as expected?
author: Poppaloora466

title: This is impossible to cancel
body: I installed this to try for free but when I tried to cancel the renewal it’s impossible. No contact no possibility to get refund from Apple. So my money was drawn from my account. And it’s expensive!!
author: S-R-E

title: I’m not rich bro
body: This app would’ve have been so helpful for me in finishing tasks and managing everything but like there isn’t even a free version of the app?? This is so sad.
author: Hemlig01101010101010101

title: Got my hopes up. And then came greed and wanted my money.
body: I’m searching for something that can help my everyday life. I thought when i saw this app that this was it. I understand that you wanna make money as a company, but that monthly fee stressed me out. Way too much money. I’m gonna try getting a digital ”ADHD-planer” on etsy instead. There, i pay waaay less and pay only ONE time.
author: jazzyjent

title: Too expensive
body: Sorry but 200 SEK / 20 US$ per month is more than a whole Netflix Premium subscription. If it was more reasonable priced, around 20 SEK / 2 US$ then maybe I'd consider it.
